scientific_question: Does removing skew-pair and disjoint-matching constraints let an equal-budget, fresh directed sparse transport cover enough of attention c_proj's exact dense-Muon request to justify implementation?

theory.orthogonal_failure: The best 6.25-percent bilateral/residual Givens chart recovered 0.236724 with cosine 0.493535. More monolithic output rotations did not help, localizing the missing capacity to the skew-paired coordinate family rather than stale direction or output-side choice alone.
theory.directed_transport: For source W and sparse directed action A, the update W A (input side) or A W (output side) gives each target channel independent incoming coefficients. Multistage residual fitting composes fresh actions without a learned dense basis.
theory.production_correspondence: The exact batched solver, ridge, chunking, family-radius normalization, and error-feedback-compatible representation are already production-qualified by the accepted MLP c_fc path. This gate changes only target and schedule allocation.

decision_rule.selection: Among passing candidates maximize aggregate fixed-scale recovery, then worst-cell recovery, then prefer lower measured solver time.
decision_rule.pass: Authorize only the selected directed c_proj implementation, focused correctness/resume tests, and an exact-config real-training MFU gate of at least 20 percent.
decision_rule.fail: Reject directed sparse transport at this budget and return to a compact state-conditioned dense-action approximation; do not sweep training schedules.

execution.monitoring: direct foreground polling; no watchdog or callback
